collection.title: Colors
collection.subtitle: Acrylic on canvas
collection.description: Small framed abstracts, painted and hung at home. Each is **one of one** — there are no prints of these.

works.title: Undertow
works.description: Blue over blue, worked *wet into wet* so the currents pull against each other rather than settle. The palest strokes went on last and were left alone.

works.title: Shallows
works.description: The green came last and stayed **thin**, so the blue underneath keeps showing through it. Painted over two evenings.

works.title: Ember
works.description: Built from the outside in. The pale centre was laid down in *a single pass* and never touched again.
